ACT XXII OF 2018
ACT XXII OF 2018
ZIAUDDIN UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Ziauddin University Act, 1995
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 18th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-PB-13/2018,
dated 18.5.2018.---The Ziauddin
University (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Sindh on 19th April, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th
May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Ziauddin
University Act, 1995, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Ziauddin University (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No. VI of 1995

2. Amendment
of section 5 of Sindh Act No. VI of 1995.---In the Ziauddin University Act, 1995, hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 5, for clause (xiv), the following shall be substituted:-
"(xiv)
to invest in or to enter into agreements, contracts, leasing agreements,
financial arrangements, and execute mortgage deeds, arrangements with
Governments, organizations, institutions, banks, including other financial
institutes, bodies and individuals for the University or on behalf of
affiliated companies, associate companies, sister concerns, other Ziauddin
Group Companies or related party to the University;".
